tagline: Leading aerospace and defense technology manufacturer
hero_kpi_rationale: Robust order growth ($24.1B in 2025) reflects sustained confidence from global airlines in next-generation LEAP engines, driven by the recovery in commercial air traffic and long-term demand for energy efficiency.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company through its operations.
kpis.description: Revenue is growing due to increased aircraft deliveries and aftermarket services.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by demand in commercial aviation.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before interest and taxes, divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving due to higher productivity and cost management.
kpis.signal: Improving operational profitability through efficiency gains.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D investments remain stable, focused on energy efficiency and advanced materials.
kpis.signal: Targeted R&D on next-generation aircraft engines.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending to acquire or upgrade physical assets such as factories or equipment.
kpis.description: Capex supports LEAP engine production capacity.
kpis.signal: Moderate capex focused on production line modernization.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash remaining after the company has paid its operating expenses and capital investments.
kpis.description: FCF is improving despite stable investments, supported by rising revenues.
kpis.signal: Improved cash flow due to better working capital management.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: GE Aerospace continues its transformation with workforce optimization.
kpis.signal: Ongoing headcount reduction to improve efficiency.

kpis.name: Net Bookings
kpis.explanation: Value of new orders signed during the year.
kpis.description: Bookings remain strong, driven by the recovery in global air traffic.
kpis.signal: Strong order backlog reflecting airline confidence.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin is slightly improving, supported by supply chain efficiency gains.
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement due to material and production cost savings.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Part des dépenses de recherche et développement dans le revenu total.
kpis.description: R&D investments remain stable, concentrated on energy efficiency and advanced materials.
kpis.signal: R&D focused on next-generation aircraft engine drivers.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $45.855 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $8.704 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 1C, cybersecurity is a significant risk for GE, with potential threats to data confidentiality and integrity.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Government regulations and industry standards may impact GE's operations, as noted in Item 1A.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the aerospace sector is high, which could impact GE's market share, as noted in Item 1A.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: Litigation and legal proceedings may have a financial impact on GE, as noted in Item 3.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events may impact GE's global operations, as noted in Item 1A.

risks.title: Technology
risks.score_rationale: Rapid technological changes may impact GE's ability to innovate and remain competitive, as noted in Item 1A.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in GE's 10-K filing for the 2025 fiscal year.
